quests.title: An Invasion on Hold

dialogue.t: Honorary Knight and The Helper in White, good news!
This is Enghiene of the Maison Gardiennage. She has already arrested the supplier behind The Unchained.
Hmph! The scoundrel was still counting money even as I kicked the door down... A proper piece of work, that one!
And it looks like your fishing spree's had the desired effect — there's been a clear reduction in the number of invasive species in these waters...
The way things are going, I'd say it won't take long before the problem's been thoroughly dealt with.
That's awesome! So, there's no need to worry about the Fonta... Uhh, Paimon meant, the quality of Fontaine's water!
You're clearly a very capable hunter! It's not just anyone who can enlist the help of {NICKNAME}, the Grand Chef Supreme of Valor...
How does that old phrase go...? That's right, like shooting gulls with a cannon!

dialogue.sit: Anything to keep those seabirds off my Fisherman's Toast...
I wouldn't mind learning how to shoot a cannon!

dialogue.t: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Officer Enghiene looks a little familiar...
Is it because we're always helping uphold the peace? Paimon must have seen a million officers by now!

dialogue.sit: Nice to meet you, Officer We've-Never-Met-But-Looks-Familiar!
Have we worked together before, officer?

dialogue.t: Hahaha! There's no need to act so formally. I'm sure we'll be working together a lot in the future, so let's try to keep it casual.
Otherwise, I'm going to have to act all serious every time I run into trouble and need your help. Can you imagine how exhausting that would be?
*sigh* I've been up to my eyeballs with this case for so long, but it looks like I can finally clock out...
I think I'll take a trip to The Rusty Rudder for a drink or two. Wait and see if that scumbag and the Unchained make an appearance on the news... Wanna join me?
Thanks for the offer, Officer Enghiene, but I can't let my guard down just yet. These invasive fish don't give up easily, y'know. Who knows what new trouble they might cause?
I can't stop until these waters are completely free of invasive species... but once I'm done, I'll come and find you for a drink!
Wow, now that's motivation! Well, guessing it might take you a while, but I'll see you there when you're done!
Give it your best and give 'em what for!

dialogue.sit: Jala returns to the water's edge to continue monitoring the situation...

dialogue.t: Paimon thinks that Miss Jala works a bit too hard...
Well, I guess... there must have been someone in her past with a really strong sense of responsibility, who had a profound effect on her... It's easy to see how she feels.
Watching her work, I don't dare slack off myself.

dialogue.sit: But work-life balance is even better.

dialogue.t: Working hard is important, but sometimes it's also good to be like {NICKNAME}. Everyone needs a good work-life balance!
In that case, if one day I come to you for professional time-management tips, you'd better not turn me away!
Anyway... I'll put in an application to the higher-ups to have the expenses for this operation — especially your remuneration — upgraded to the "Main-Cannon-Operational-Expenses" band.
Hopefully, the next time I run into trouble, you two will already be there...
With any luck, you'll be standing there, hands on hips, greeting me with a smile and a resounding "The problem's already been solved!"

quests.description: After a spate of spirited fishing, you manage to halt the spread of invasive fish in Fontaine’s waters. Meanwhile, you receive some good news from the Maison Gardiennage…
